title: Plunge bounds for Fourier concentration operators: geometry, smoothing, and wave packets
summary: We prove a single-logarithm bound for the eigenvalues in the plunge region of Fourier concentration operators, removing the extra logarithmic factor in the Kulikov--Dam Larsen bound for two general admissible sets throughout each fixed exponential window.
